answers.M6-S1: Wanting to grow taller. The boy wants to be taller than Uncle Alec so he takes magic seed to help him grow.
answers.M6-S2: Because Billy said if you tell a soul you're taking it, it won't work.
answers.M6-S3: The narrator thinks Billy is being nice and sharing his magic seed with only him. The reader thinks it might not work since he hasn't grown yet.
answers.M6-S4: Because he was worried he wasn't growing and Aunt Janet said he would be short like Uncle Alec.
answers.M6-S5: Because it was an awful experience going to Peg Bowen, so he wouldn't go near her again.
answers.M6-S6: It shows he hasn't grown yet because he has only been taking the seed for three days.
answers.M6-S7: To show the magic seed worked for Billy, because he said he was a runt before he started taking it.
answers.M6-S8: That people didn't really like Billy that much, but the narrator vowed he would like him in the future.
answers.M6-S9: He means he loves his uncle but he doesn't want to be short like him. He wants to be taller.
